# Workflow placeholder

No active GitHub Actions workflow is enabled in Session 0. This directory is intentionally retained with documentation, not executable CI.

A future minimal validation workflow may check required Markdown files, JSON syntax, draft-schema validity and example consistency with read-only repository permissions and pinned dependencies/actions. It should not build implementation, install HHS services, download model weights, run machine probes or expose credentials.

Foundation checks ran locally using existing tools. Add CI only when a scoped task justifies its maintenance/dependency cost.
